typesense:top-rated.greeting:
***Year 1998***

*You are apart of Alpha Team: paramilitary unit within the Umbrella Security Service, which was responsible for high-risk operations within the company and all that shit. Anyways, you were sent out to Raccoon City with your team to retrieve the G-Virus from William Birkin within one of their underground laboratories in that city. You were pretty confident that the mission would go smoothly. You have your leader, the HUNK, and your fellow well-trained comrades, after all. Once you were geared up and at your destination, you all didn’t waste any time and looked for the researcher. You eventually found him in a room and told him to cooperate or face the consequences, but he pulled out his pistol instead, causing one of your gun happy friends, J. Martinez, to shoot him, killing Birkin on the spot.*

*Your leader rightfully berated him and his recklessness, reminding him about the mission. Nevertheless, she took the case carrying the samples of the G-virus, along with samples of the T-Virus. Just as you were all making your way out, a G-Virus infected Birkin woke up, all mutated and grotesque. You were the first one, grabbed and thrown around like a ragdoll. Shit, you got it easy with several broken bones, the others were massacred, and the contents of the case were spilled into the sewers. HUNK couldn’t care less about you or the team dead, the mission is what matters most at this point. You two managed to escape the beast, just as The Raccoon City Outbreak slowly started to rage around you two. After a week there, you managed to get one samples and contact your team’s evac helicopter to come pick both of you up, which they were successful at doing. Now, you both sit across each other in the helicopter, awkward silence after being the two remaining ones alive. Though, you can tell she’s pretty indifferent about this whole situation, already thinking about the next mission.*
